properties.name: Quai Antoine exhibition/residential complex
properties.identity: The OSM museum/exhibition tag is a ground-floor use and cannot establish the height of this whole long complex. The Ruscino residential address 14 Quai Antoine is distinguished from OSM address 4; neither the six-level western frontage nor every annex is labelled as a nine-storey residence.
properties.roof_parts: Measured parent boundary, separate inner component BATIMENT0000000074074345, and western low annexes BATIMENT0000000074074434/4442 are all retained. The parent polygon hole belongs to the separate inner roof; it is not an empty courtyard. The 95.2%-covered industrial OSM footprint is claimed by the measured parent to avoid a duplicate low shell.
properties.estimated_details: Western panel grid, wide glazing, pale surrounds, alternating ground arches and balcony rail rhythm follow 494/496/498 and 1158/1160 s. Window bays 4.8 m, storey module 3.5 m, shallow balcony projection 0.48 m and masonry-joint dimensions are estimates. The far eastern wing keeps its actual source rise; an explicitly retained internal roof seam reconstructs the storey step rather than inventing a continuous ramp.
properties.material: MonacoRuscinoRose, original matte linear tint 0.56/0.36/0.32, not copied game pixels.
properties.western_annex_ground_qualification: The two low western annexes likewise use the common mapped ground/IGN roof area, retaining measured eaves beyond it as closed cantilevers. Roof-to-fence clearance is at least1.7476 m and7.6983 m; all ground bodies remain clear of existing walls.

properties.name: Ermanno Palace
properties.geometry: Detailed curved OSM floorplate, 1.7 m estimated recessed balcony core, measured sloping eaves and a3.5 m estimated inset roof room below the 48.6 m source peak. The selling agent exterior supports rounded wraparound balconies and an inset roof terrace. Roof-room plan and floor spacing are estimates, not a surveyed section.
properties.nearby_source_check: All eight returned building features were tested. The seven other features have zero overlap with Ermanno; the nearest taller neighbour is 7.05 m away. No separate source component supplies a hidden 61 m tower.

properties.name: Le Mirabeau
properties.height_qualification: The existing 81 m architectural height is independently listed by the building-height authority. The matching IGN component reports 84.9 m. The reason for that 3.9 m discrepancy is not established; both values remain in the source record and the existing 81 m envelope is retained for this facade correction.
properties.geometry: Open 2.1 m estimated loggias, thin white floorplates and metal rails replace the flat grid. The mapped north-west wall spanning vertices 0-2 is the solid spine to the left in the eastward 1176 s view; two narrow vertical window stacks distinguish it from the open south loggias. Depths, bay spacing and window proportions remain estimates.

properties.name: Le Parc Spelugues / Fairmont approach
properties.geometry: Stone wall 1.8 m high and 0.28 m thick, reconstructed 0.8 m inside the actual park boundary. Low hedge 3.0±0.4 m sits behind it. Only strips and roots within the actual park and clear of unchanged protection are emitted. Existing source ground and mature mapped trees remain.
properties.qualification: The wall itself is not mapped; its inset, section and hedge spacing are disclosed visual estimates from 1180 s, not independently surveyed wall coordinates. Mapped retaining walls 1488095480/481 are on the opposite street side and are not repurposed as this wall.

properties.name: La Rascasse
properties.qualification: Its old overall height was already close. The large problem was a roof footprint being treated as a solid ground wall. The independently mapped roof1082340323 remains untouched. Exact door/floor subdivision and frame spacing remain estimates; no source pixel textures are used.
properties.owner_date_qualification: The 2026 release confirms the property at 1 Quai Antoine. Its recent interior renovation is not treated as evidence of 2025 external trim.
properties.geometry: The retained OSM ground body and measured IGN roof differ. The closed room volume uses their common plan area, keeping all ground-level walls and columns inside the original mapped body. The full measured roof remains above its 64.59 m² overhang, with an original 0.18 m closed fascia/soffit and recessed dark metal/glass room front. This separation follows the owner exterior tour and avoids extruding roof-only area down through the existing event protection. Source plan disagreement remains within the retained mapping uncertainty; the common room outline is a reconstruction, not a surveyed ground-floor plan.
properties.owner_tour_observation: The linked terrace tour directly shows a recessed glazed room front, open covered seating, dark metal posts, glass screens and roof/louvre framing. The tour image date is not established; it supports the roof/room relationship and material form, not a claim about 2026 interior trim or event-fence dimensions.

roof_protection.existing_native_wall_and_ground_body: No intersection. Existing and authored ground bodies have zero barrier-centerline crossing.
roof_protection.generic_fence_defect: The blanket visual catch fence and maximum post envelope intersect the low roof by 0.82294 m / 1.27294 m. A source-owned overhead ceiling is required for the decorative fence; the measured roof and native collision wall must remain unchanged.
roof_protection.status: Corrected with four measured downward soffit faces registered to the default-empty shared decorative-fence ceiling hook. All 435 actual fence/post intersection witnesses clear by at least 0.12 m; the full concrete geometry stream and native protection are unchanged.

media_policy: Reference video stills and owner/builder photos stay ignored under build/reviews. Only open source numeric geometry, source URLs, hashes and original code-native forms are versioned; no reference pixels ship in the game.
review_gate: Fresh source-identified cockpit captures, followed by Luna High review. No visual approval is claimed by source or geometry checks.

fence_and_post_clearance.qualification: Actual current barrier producer and all current native segments, with source-owned soffits. The test checks projected intersection coordinates against each source roof face and conservatively uses the maximum emitted fence/post triangle height. Native concrete is byte-identical in source coordinates, and no profile/limit/physics files are modified.

ground_roof_distinction.qualification: Wall/fence plane heights use the exact current exporter bottom/top values. The3.6m post result is a conservative continuous height envelope; actual posts occur at4m intervals and may not occupy its lowest spot. No native protection is changed.

focused_checks: Measured source roof vertices, separate component hole and storey step survive poisoned exterior ground.
Ermanno ignores stale61 m/18-storey data and removes ground only under its emitted detailed floorplate.
La Rascasse preserves the measured roof and downward soffit while leaving ground beneath its open overhang.
Default-empty fence output matches the actual6a970d40 producer byte-for-byte; capped wire/posts leave concrete unchanged.
Every retained property supplies2D-only terrain masks, including holes; clipped ground emission succeeds while the full architectural triangle stream remains unchanged.
geometry_validation.qualification: These are source geometry and data checks. They do not replace fresh packaged visual review.

terrain_mask_correction_20261113.cause: Measured roof rings are three-dimensional. Passing them or their intersections directly into terrain_cutouts propagated Z through Shapely terrain differences, whose ground tessellator requires XY coordinates.
terrain_mask_correction_20261113.correction: All parent/inner component masks and both annex/La Rascasse body intersections explicitly construct XY-only polygons, including every interior ring. The separate roof polygons remain three-dimensional. No shared terrain API or geometric data was changed.
terrain_mask_correction_20261113.invariant: The complete emitted private architecture/garden stream is byte-identical in source positions/materials before and after the mask-only fix.
terrain_mask_correction_20261113.regression: All retained property styles populate only2D terrain masks, preserve the source inner component hole, and emit a surrounding clipped ground polygon without coordinate unpacking failure.
